notes: Revenue by service line sourced from customer revenue analysis (sourceDocumentId: 31f2fdc8-f73a-4f5b-926a-08bb30b9ddd6) and reconciled to T2 returns and reviewed financial statements.
Fuel surcharge revenue (~$3.05M in 2024) is included in the service line revenue figures above, not broken out separately.

Total shareholder management salaries per Schedule 3 were $488K (2022), $505K (2023), $522K (2024). These have been split into: Harjit $285K (owner, customer-facing role), Surinder $62K (non-working, income-splitting), and Manpreet as the working VP Operations (balance).

One-time expenses carved out: 2022 facility relocation $186K; 2023 union certification legal $58K; 2024 TMS migration consultants $72K and wrongful dismissal settlement $55K. These amounts were embedded in Professional fees and Other expenses in the source statements.

Professional fees line reduced by one-time amounts: 2023 reduced by $58K (union legal), 2024 reduced by $72K (TMS) + $55K (settlement) = $127K. Remaining professional fees are recurring (accounting, legal, consulting).
Gain on disposal of equipment is shown as positive Other Income (contra to the negative presentation in some source statements).

All figures tie to T2 returns (sourceDocumentIds: 04d12713-efe6-42bb-a398-7738cd080167 for 2022, d90845b4-33e7-4dec-a89e-89f49f216cf5 for 2023, 5a98061d-9385-477d-ad1a-8ecfc3a09a27 for 2024) and reviewed financial statements (sourceDocumentIds: a978399e-149d-42ed-8a4c-0d5d8cf38d9d for 2022, 72650f77-4ed1-4c2b-85de-9f22919917b6 for 2023, 6583bbd5-0b9f-4b82-a942-b475a058a251 for 2024).
Net income per year: 2022 $1,115,900; 2023 $665,915; 2024 $972,960 — these match the T2 returns and reviewed statements exactly.

Net income computed from these rows does not tie to the reported net income in the normalization — 2024: Income Statement 1,044,960 vs reported 972,960 (+72,000). Check for a carved-out one-time item still included in its parent line, or a line item missing from the extraction.
Normalized EBITDA (broker methodology, per confirmed facts): 2022 $3.78M, 2023 $3.31M, 2024 $3.90M.
Calculation: Net income + Interest + Taxes + D&A + One-time expenses − Gain on disposal − Below-market rent adjustment.

Seller initially claimed $4.1M adjusted EBITDA for 2024 (adding back Harjit's full $285K salary with no replacement cost deduction). Broker normalized to $3.90M by deducting $120K replacement cost and $78K below-market rent adjustment.

Below-market yard rent: The operating company pays $96K/year to the family holding company for the Barnston Road yard. Market rent per October 2025 appraisal is $174K/year. The $78K difference is a DEDUCTION from EBITDA because a buyer will pay market rent (either to the family under a new lease or to a third party if they relocate).

Owner compensation: Harjit's $285K salary is for customer relationship management (Alderbrook, dairy co-op, etc.). A buyer would need to replace this role at an estimated $120K, so the addback is $165K. Surinder's $62K is pure income-splitting with no operational role, so it's a full addback. Manpreet's salary ($141K-$175K) is market for a working VP Operations and is NOT added back.
One-time expenses: 2022 facility relocation $186K (move to Campbell Ridge); 2023 union legal $58K (certification vote failed); 2024 TMS migration $72K + wrongful dismissal $55K = $127K total.
Gain on disposal: Equipment sales generated gains of $118K (2022), $72K (2023), $64K (2024). These are non-operating and removed from normalized EBITDA.

EBITDA margin trend (per confirmed facts): 13.2% (2022) → 11.3% (2023) → 12.6% (2024). The 2023 dip was due to full-year Campbell Ridge rent and higher equipment loan rates; 2024 recovery driven by 35% warehouse revenue growth (higher-margin than trucking).
For SDE purposes (if a buyer wants owner-operator metrics), add the full owner comp addbacks ($227K/year) to the EBITDA figures above.

Reported net income does not tie to the Income Statement rows — 2024: Income Statement 1,044,960 vs reported 972,960 (+72,000). The normalization starts from the reported figure; review the Income Statement reclassification before relying on either.
